svg.title: Simon Oakes - Senior Linux, DevOps and Platform Engineer
svg.desc: UK-based, 25+ years in production. Automation-first infrastructure; production systems that stay calm. A terminal dry-runs ansible-playbook site.yml with --check --diff and reports nothing changed: repeatable, observable, recoverable, calm. The dotted Earth rises beneath it with London lit.
svg.text: Automation-first infrastructure. Production systems that stay calm.
